svg.title: How I break down a problem: Engineering (how it works): System first, then the screen. → Systems (how it connects): Problems live between screens. → Design (how it's made): I design how teams build it. → AI (how it's built): AI informs. Judgment decides. → People (who it's for): People trust what they understand.

g.text: I design how teams build it.
